name: wakecore
description: Build React interfaces with WakeCore templates, adaptable components, and mandatory validation.

interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to the hosted WakeCore knowledge server. It uses exact templates when available, otherwise adapts nearby templates or composes WakeCore-aligned UI, with WakeCore-only validation before completion.
defaultPrompt: Create the React app if needed, then build this UI using an exact WakeCore template or the automatic adaptation and composition fallback.
Refactor this screen to use WakeCore and validate it.
Plan a WakeCore-only implementation for this interface.
